about.text: The Finnish soured milk drink, tart and thicker than milk. Pasteurised milk is fermented at 18–24 °C for 15–24 hours. It is also the buttermilk left from churning cultured cream (kirnupiimä). Western Finland traditionally made a stringy long piimä, eastern Finland a curdled one.

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

facts.v: Thicker than milk; modern piimä is the western 'long' ropy type
